image_description: A white minibus with a high-roof conversion, parked on a gravel surface. The vehicle features a row of side windows, a front windshield, and visible text/logos on the side and front. Several people are standing in the background to the left. The image quality is low resolution with noticeable compression artifacts.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic boxy silhouette of a van-based minibus. The high-roof modification confirms sufficient interior height.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible. A row of rectangular side windows runs along the passenger compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is tall relative to its width. The driver's door is visible at the front, consistent with minibus design.
The passenger entrance door is located on the far side of the vehicle (right side) which is not visible from this camera angle. Only the driver's door is visible.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout typical of this class of vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is completely occluded by the viewing angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is white with blue lettering/logos ('Inter...') on the side and front, consistent with commercial livery.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel matches the size and style of standard commercial van wheels.
The window configuration and overall dimensions align with a vehicle designed for 4-10 passengers.

artifact_observations.location: Side and front of the minibus
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the side ('Inter...') and front is distorted and illegible. While some blurring is expected due to low image resolution, the character shapes appear malformed and inconsistent with standard typography, suggesting AI generation artifacts or severe compression distortion mimicking AI failure.

The people in the background lack distinct anatomical features, appearing as smeared color blobs. The ground texture is overly uniform and noisy, lacking realistic gravel detail. This suggests a failure in rendering fine details, common in AI-generated scenes or heavily compressed synthetic images.
The front bumper geometry appears slightly warped and lacks sharp definition. The grille details merge into the headlight housing without clear separation, indicating minor structural ambiguity.

To analyze the illegible text on the vehicle side and front to determine if it is gibberish (AI artifact) or just blurry real text.
To assess the overall coherence of the scene, specifically distinguishing between natural low-resolution noise and AI-generated smearing/melting in the background and vehicle edges.
To check for fusion artifacts between the tires and the ground, and ensure the wheel rims are topologically correct circles.
To verify if the background figures have valid depth separation from the minibus or if they bleed into the vehicle geometry.

Wheel-ground contact points and rim geometry

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the side of the bus. If the OCR expert finds no recognizable characters, treat this as a strong signal of AI generation. Also, scrutinize the background people; if they lack distinct limbs or faces, this supports the 'texture_anomaly' observation. Do not let the low resolution of the image excuse structural impossibilities in the vehicle itself.
